card.line: The Valley of Beracah is a valley near Engedi where Judah's people blessed the LORD after He gave them victory over their enemies in Jehoshaphat's day.

moments.title: Blessing the LORD
moments.text: After three days of gathering plunder, the people of Judah met in the valley on the fourth day and blessed the LORD. The place was named the Valley of Beracah because of this.
